title: Concept drift mitigation through community and spectral graph analysis for the detection of cyberattacks in network traffic
abstract: arXiv:2609.09442v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In network traffic, legitimate behaviours and attack techniques evolve jointly - the phenomenon known as 'concept drift' [1]. Every detector is thereby left obsolete between two updates, and always one step behind adversaries. In this work, we propose to move the point of intervention from the model, repaired after the drift, to the feature space, selected before learning. We therefore introduce t-robustness, a stability score defined for each feature independently of any detection model, comparable across an entire feature space. It combines the step-by-step distance between successive statistical states of a feature, and its cumulative divergence from its initial state, so that a slow monotonic drift cannot pass for stability. The candidates are drawn from abnormal network connectivity patterns left by scans, DoS and communications between endpoints, read through graph community metrics and spectral metrics. translated_title: 通过社区图谱与谱图分析缓解概念漂移以检测网络流量中的网络攻击
translated_abstract: 在网络流量中，合法行为和攻击技术会共同演变——这一现象被称为“概念漂移”。因此，每个检测器在两次更新之间都会变得过时，始终落后于攻击者一步。在这项工作中，我们建议将干预点从模型层面（在漂移发生后进行修复）转移到特征空间层面（在学习之前进行选择）。为此，我们引入了t-鲁棒性（t-robustness），这是一个针对每个特征独立定义的稳定性评分，不依赖于任何检测模型，并且可以在整个特征空间中进行比较。它结合了特征在连续统计状态之间的逐步距离及其相对于初始状态的累积偏差，使得缓慢的单调漂移无法被误认为稳定性。候选特征来源于扫描攻击、DoS攻击和端点间通信所留下的异常网络连接模式，并通过图社区指标和谱指标进行解读。评估（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种独立于检测模型的特征稳定性评分“t-鲁棒性”，通过在学习前利用图社区与谱分析从异常网络连接模式中选取抗漂移特征，而非在漂移后修复模型，从而缓解网络流量攻击检测中的概念漂移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "t-robustness", a model-independent feature stability score that mitigates concept drift in network traffic attack detection by selecting drift-robust features (via graph community and spectral analysis) before learning, rather than repairing models after drift occurs.
